name: bench500
description: Final report of the sciai-lab extraction-model benchmark (September 2026). Eight extraction configurations (local and API LLMs) were run over a frozen set of 500 Parkinson's-disease papers (350 full-text, 150 abstract-only); 2,117 extraction items were hand-adjudicated by domain experts. The report covers structural validity, content correctness, and relation-direction agreement, and records the reversal of the provisional ranking after expert adjudication. Includes the frozen 500-paper set (JSON) for reproduction. Produced within the sciai-lab pipeline (https://sciai.eu).
